name: B10-0493/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Commission Implementing Decision renewing the authorisation for the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified soybean MON 87708, pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to renew the licence for a genetically modified soybean, called MON 87708. The soybean is engineered to survive spraying with the herbicide dicamba. The Parliament says the safety checks missed long-term and combined effects, and that dicamba harms soil, water, wildlife and neighbouring farms. It also says the licence should not be renewed. This is the Parliament's opinion; the Commission makes the final decision.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks the Commission to withdraw the plan and refuse renewal.
- **Who it affects:** Farmers, food and feed businesses, and consumers in the EU, plus exporting farmers abroad.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw, change or keep its plan. Parliament also wants a new law to reform how genetically modified organisms are approved.
